entities.name: Five royal courts of the Realm

claims.subject: eldraine
claims.source_excerpt: it is ruled over by five royal courts: Ardenvale, Vantress, Locthwain, Embereth, and Garenbrig.
claims.summary: Eldraine's Realm is organized around five named royal courts, distinct from a claim about every region of the plane.
claims.limitation: The guide describes the human Realm within Eldraine; it does not claim those courts governed the Wilds or later held unchanged power.

claims.subject: eldraine
claims.source_excerpt: Eight or nine generations ago, humans rose to power and drove the elves out of what would become the realm.
claims.summary: The 2019 guide says humans rose to rule the Realm and displaced elves after an earlier elven era.
claims.limitation: The eight-or-nine-generation span is relative to the 2019 guide's in-world narration, not an established AR calendar date or a claim that all elves left Eldraine.

claims.subject: ikoria
claims.source_excerpt: Drannith is the largest human sanctuary on the plane
claims.summary: Vivien's 2020 Ikoria guide describes Drannith as its largest human sanctuary.
claims.limitation: The guide records a 2020 travel-era description; it is not proof of Drannith's survival or size after later invasions.

claims.subject: ikoria
claims.source_excerpt: Skysail is a "city" in the sky made of dozens of balloon-driven airships.
claims.summary: Skysail is an airborne Ikorian human sanctuary formed from connected balloon-driven airships.
claims.limitation: A dated description of a mobile sanctuary, not a fixed-coordinate location or proof of its later condition.

claims.subject: new_capenna
claims.source_excerpt: This place would hold the plane: this fortress became a city, a city the people called New Capenna.
claims.summary: The towering city of New Capenna was created as refuge during a devastating war against Old Capenna.
claims.limitation: This is the city's founding story within the plane's history, not proof that the city geographically encompasses every part of the plane.

claims.subject: new_capenna
claims.source_excerpt: It was only through the intervention of Old Capenna's archangels and their hosts that the plane's mortal defenders stood a chance.
claims.summary: Old Capenna's archangels helped mortal defenders resist the invasion before the city was founded.
claims.limitation: A pre-city historical role; the angels' later fate and political status are not inferred from this earlier defense.

claims.subject: new_capenna
claims.source_excerpt: Old Capenna, is gone, lost in a cataclysmic war against a forgotten enemy
claims.summary: Old Capenna endured a destructive invasion by an enemy the 2022 overview deliberately leaves unnamed.
claims.limitation: The source calls the enemy forgotten; this claim does NOT identify it as Phyrexia or settle later historical interpretations.

claims.subject: argentum
claims.source_excerpt: Mirrodin, originally known as Argentum, was created by the Planeswalker Karn.
claims.summary: Karn created the metallic world originally called Argentum, later called Mirrodin.
claims.limitation: This is the historical plane creation, not a statement about Karn's control or the plane's current name after later events.

claims.subject: argentum
claims.source_excerpt: Karn left him to watch over the metallic plane of Argentum
claims.summary: Karn's creation Memnarch was assigned to watch over the plane when it was called Argentum.
claims.limitation: The claim concerns his original caretaker role, not his later corruption or continuing guardianship.

claims.subject: argentum
claims.source_excerpt: The contagion also infected the plane, destabilizing its interior core of pure mana
claims.summary: A contagion introduced to Argentum spread into the plane itself, changing its inner core.
claims.limitation: The 2008 overview describes the early metal-world era; later Phyrexian transformation and the source's historical naming are separate questions.

claims.subject: argentum
claims.summary: Memnarch renamed Argentum to Mirrodin; this is an earlier naming transition, not its complete later name history.
claims.limitation: The source describes a past renaming by Memnarch. The plane later bore the name New Phyrexia, so this is not its current canonical name.

remaining: Other thin planes still need independent official histories, not synthetic filler claims.
Do not combine Realm-only social structure with all of Eldraine or treat in-world narrator dates as AR chronology.
Do not name the forgotten Old Capenna invaders from outside this official historical account.
Do not infer current Ikoria settlement status, present-day Capenna politics or post-March of the Machine Phyrexian control.
No lore decks, owner approval or full foundation certification follows.
